task: Review every supplied part, discover the most consequential events from the supplied evidence, cluster related reports, assign the best-fit broad news category dynamically and produce up to 150 processed stories using schema/processed-news.schema.json. The final portfolio must contain at least five well-supported stories in every category. Treat social attention as a discovery signal rather than verification. More than half of the final stories must originate with independent, local or social discovery, using the first source in each story as the discovery source; established outlets may account for no more than half.

items.title: Phone used in Siddaramaiah sting row videos handed over at Kumaraswamy’s residence: Police
items.summary: The mobile phone allegedly used to upload videos targeting former Karnataka chief minister Siddaramaiah was handed over to an associate at Union Minister HD Kumaraswamy’s official residence in New Delhi, Bengaluru Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh said on Sunday, November 1. The claim is based on the statement of an accused, and police said they are still verifying the details. The Commissioner said Ritesh Pandey, who was arrested in Delhi on October 24, told investigators that he and Vinod Sharma bought the phone from a shop in Karol Bagh on the instructions of Prajwal Prasad. The two allegedly took the device to Kumaraswamy’s residence on Kushak Road and handed it over to Prajwal, who was present there. “Arrested suspect Ritesh Pandey revealed that he and another person, Vinod Sharma, acted on the instructions of one Prajwal Prasad. This is as per Pandey’s statement. Both Prasad and Sharma are absconding and have moved anticipatory bail petitions,” Seemant said. The commissioner said investigators were examining technical evidence, including CCTV footage and digital records, as well as financial transactions between Ritesh and Prajwal.
